title: top-up: in-flight host-disk park respects the cargo project
definition: Reviewed the tree-manifest discovery shared by the milestone merge gate and the in-flight host-disk park. The module lists every Deno and Cargo project in a checkout, breadth-first to a fixed depth, and an unreadable directory contributes no manifest. The in-flight park uses it so that a merge-only host-disk admission parks only a checkout holding a cargo project, while a below-floor admission still parks every checkout.
